subarea: Uploaded node + link launch then switch to Map with zipcode mapping
file_types: node + link
description: Load uploaded node and distance-link files, launch the network, switch to Map, and map nodes by zipcode.
primary_assertions: Map view opens; zipcode field maps to Zip_code; global stats render; Map layer counts can be asserted deterministically after configuration.
notes: This is the maintained uploaded-data Map smoke baseline and runs in the regular journeys/flows suite.

file_types: node + link with partial zipcode coverage
description: After selecting zipcode mapping, verify nodes lacking location data are omitted from Map rendering and listed in the Excluded Nodes dialog.
primary_assertions: Excluded node count shows 3; the dialog lists P1, P2, and P3; omitted nodes are absent from rendered Map node layers.
notes: This specifically covers the Map-only omission path rather than general network visibility.

file_types: uploaded SNP node + distance link
description: Change the distance threshold while Map is active, verify rendered link counts update, then restore the original threshold.
primary_assertions: Map rendered logical link count moves from 46 to 73 and back to 46; rendered located node count stays 30; the global visible-link metric stays in sync.
notes: Threshold 24 resolves to 73 logical visible links here because the CSV contains one duplicate undirected pair.

file_types: node with lat/lon columns
description: Load uploaded coordinates directly through latitude and longitude fields instead of zipcode lookup.
primary_assertions: Map renders nodes from explicit coordinates; rendered Leaflet marker coordinates match the uploaded lat/long values exactly; excluded-node handling stays coherent on the zero-excluded path.
notes: The AngularTesting map node fixture already provides a small deterministic explicit-coordinate path, so no extra fixture was needed.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Toggle node collapsing on uploaded data and verify Map switches between clustered and uncollapsed node rendering without changing logical membership.
primary_assertions: With zipcode mapping active, uncollapsed mode renders 30 nodes through the feature group; collapsed mode moves those same 30 nodes into the marker-cluster group; restoring Off returns feature-group rendering.
notes: This migrates the highest-value collapsing behavior out of the old sample-data spec into the maintained uploaded-data journeys run.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Adjust Map node transparency on uploaded data and verify the rendered Leaflet node layers update without changing membership.
primary_assertions: map-node-transparency updates in session widgets; rendered node stroke and fill opacity drop from 1 to 0.25; node membership remains stable.
notes: Covered alongside collapsing and visibility controls in the maintained uploaded-data Map controls journey.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Adjust Map link transparency on uploaded data and verify the rendered Leaflet link layers update without changing membership.
primary_assertions: map-link-transparency updates in session widgets; rendered link opacity drops from 1 to 0.25; logical rendered link count stays stable.
notes: Covered alongside collapsing and visibility controls in the maintained uploaded-data Map controls journey.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Hide and restore nodes and links on uploaded Map data.
primary_assertions: Hiding links detaches only the link layer; hiding nodes clears only the node-rendering layer; showing them again restores the prior rendered state.
notes: This keeps the assertions deterministic by targeting uploaded data, zipcode mapping, and direct Leaflet layer state instead of sample-data-only view-state coverage.

file_types: node + link with date field
description: Apply Timeline while Map is active and assert deterministic Map node and link membership at exact checkpoints.
primary_assertions: Global timeline stats stay aligned with the oracle; rendered Map nodes and logical links match the oracle after filtering out nodes without zipcode data.
notes: This reuses the existing timeline oracle snapshots and adds the Map-specific zipcode visibility layer on top.

subarea: Uploaded node and link color mappings on Map
file_types: uploaded node + link with categorical node and link fields
description: Set Color Nodes By and Color Links By from Global Settings on uploaded data while Map is active and verify Leaflet rendering reflects the selected categorical variables.
primary_assertions: Rendered Map node fill colors differ by Profession; rendered Map link colors differ by Contact type; the corresponding color tables appear and stay aligned with the chosen variables.
notes: This is the maintained uploaded-data Map color baseline.

subarea: Targeted color table edits on Map
file_types: uploaded node + link with categorical node and link fields
description: Edit one node color-table entry and one link color-table entry on uploaded data while Map is active.
primary_assertions: Only the targeted Profession node layers and Contact type link layers take the edited colors; unaffected categories keep their baseline colors.
notes: This keeps the higher-risk table-edit path under maintained uploaded-data coverage instead of sample-data-only coverage.

subarea: Direct file launch to Map default view
file_types: node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Set File Settings default view to Map before launch and confirm the uploaded dataset reaches an interactive Map without hanging behind Processing Files.
primary_assertions: The Processing Files overlay clears; default-view stays set to Map; the direct-launch Map view becomes interactive; zipcode mapping on the same launched session still renders the expected 30 located nodes and 46 logical links.
notes: This direct-launch path is now part of maintained uploaded-data coverage after Map began publishing its own render-complete signal instead of depending on the 2D launch path.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Change the Map node jitter amount and reroll the jittered positions on uploaded zipcode-mapped data.
primary_assertions: map-node-jitter updates in session widgets; reroll changes the stored jitter angle and offset for at least one rendered uploaded Map node.
notes: This is now covered on maintained uploaded data using rendered Leaflet node layers instead of only the sample-data clustered-marker path.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Exercise countries, states, and counties offline layer toggles on uploaded Map data.
primary_assertions: Countries, states, and counties toggles update their backing session widgets and the matching Leaflet layer attachment state; visible offline layers also populate features after loading.
notes: This is now covered in the maintained uploaded-data Map layers journey after the initial layer-settings sync race was removed.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Verify the online basemap layer is present on uploaded Map data and that the baseline layer widgets match the rendered Leaflet state.
primary_assertions: map-basemap-show is true on the maintained uploaded baseline; the Leaflet basemap layer is attached; satellite and countries/counties stay detached; the default states overlay remains attached because map-states-show defaults to true.
notes: This maintained baseline now asserts the actual uploaded Map widget defaults instead of relying on the pre-fix settings-dialog race.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Toggle the online satellite layer on uploaded Map data and verify the Leaflet satellite layer attaches without disturbing uploaded location mapping.
primary_assertions: map-satellite-show updates in session widgets; the Leaflet satellite layer is attached when enabled; uploaded zipcode mapping and rendered Map counts remain stable.
notes: This is now covered on the maintained uploaded-data path as part of the Map tab persistence journey; basemap now has its own maintained uploaded-data coverage as well.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Pan the uploaded Map through the rendered map container, then use Center Screen to return to the baseline center.
primary_assertions: Leaflet center coordinates change after the drag path and return close to the original uploaded-data center after Center Screen; zoom stays stable during the pan step.
notes: This is now covered on maintained uploaded data using the zipcode-mapped Map fixture instead of only on the sample dataset.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Use the zoom-in and zoom-out controls on uploaded Map data and verify the rendered zoom level changes deterministically.
primary_assertions: A zoom-in control click increases the Leaflet zoom level by one; a zoom-out control click returns the zoom to baseline; Center Screen restores the baseline view afterward.
notes: This is now covered in a maintained uploaded-data journey; the older sample-data spec still exercises a longer multi-click zoom sequence, but it is no longer the only regression signal.

file_types: uploaded node + link with categorical node fields
description: Trigger a rendered node hover on uploaded Map data and verify the configured node-tooltip content renders and hides correctly.
primary_assertions: The Map tooltip becomes visible for the hovered uploaded node, shows the active node tooltip field value, and hides on mouseout.
notes: The maintained uploaded-data journey currently verifies the default uploaded `_id` node tooltip path on a small deterministic Map fixture.

file_types: uploaded node + link with categorical link fields
description: Set a Map link tooltip field on uploaded data and trigger a rendered link hover.
primary_assertions: The Map tooltip becomes visible for the hovered uploaded link, shows the selected link field value, and hides on mouseout.
notes: This is now covered on a small deterministic uploaded Map fixture instead of only on the sample dataset.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Click a rendered uploaded Map node and verify selection state propagates to both rendering and backing model.
primary_assertions: The rendered node switches to the selected stroke color and width; the matching visible node in commonService becomes selected; no unrelated visible node stays selected on the single-select path.
notes: This is now covered on a small deterministic uploaded Map fixture instead of only on the sample dataset.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Export the uploaded Map view as a PNG file.
primary_assertions: The export dialog opens; writing a non-empty PNG file into cypress/downloads succeeds on the uploaded zipcode-mapped dataset.
notes: This is now covered in a maintained uploaded-data journey rather than only in the sample-data Map spec.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Enable a Map layer such as satellite, close the Map tab, reopen it, and verify the layer preference persists on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: The selected satellite layer remains enabled after closing and reopening the Map tab; uploaded zipcode mapping and uncollapsed rendered Map counts persist across the reopen.
notes: This persistence path is now covered on uploaded data instead of only in the old sample-data Map view-state spec.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Set a fixed global node color while Map is active and verify rendered Map nodes update.
primary_assertions: node-color updates in session widgets; collapsed visible leaf markers and uncollapsed rendered node layers both adopt the fixed uploaded Map node color.
notes: This is now covered on the maintained uploaded-data path in both collapsed and uncollapsed node modes.

file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Set a fixed global link color while Map is active and verify rendered Map links update.
primary_assertions: link-color updates in session widgets; rendered Map link layers adopt the requested fixed color; rendered logical link count stays coherent on the uploaded zipcode fixture.
notes: This is now covered on the maintained uploaded-data path after the uploaded link color-by default stopped being forced back to origin on load.

subarea: Threshold-driven cluster color recompute on Map
file_types: uploaded node + link with zipcode mapping
description: Color nodes and links by Cluster, then change the threshold and verify Map colors update with the new cluster membership.
primary_assertions: Before and after the threshold change, rendered Map node and link colors match the populated cluster color tables; at least one rendered node and one rendered link change cluster membership and recolor when the threshold rises from 16 to 24.
notes: This maintained uploaded-data journey now covers the Map cluster recompute path end to end; the spec waits for the asynchronously populated link color table before extracting rows.

file_types: uploaded style-capable dataset
description: Apply a style file and verify Map node colors, link colors, layer toggles, and tooltip configuration update coherently on uploaded Map data.
primary_assertions: Applied style widgets match expected values; rendered Map node colors, basemap/countries layer state, tooltip configuration, and rendered Map link colors all match the applied style-table state.
notes: The old blocker came from a stale hardcoded link-color expectation. The maintained spec now asserts rendered Map link colors against the applied style-table mapping itself.

file_types: uploaded node + link with date field
description: Enable Timeline on uploaded Map data, start playback, stop it, and confirm the visible date and rendered membership advance coherently.
primary_assertions: The play button toggles between Play and Pause; the slider label advances beyond the initial date; rendered Map node ids stay aligned with the timeline-visible nodes that actually have map coordinates after playback.
notes: The deterministic checkpoint oracle already covered exact dates; this adds maintained uploaded-data playback mechanics.

file_types: uploaded node + link with date field and zipcode mapping
description: Change node and link colors during timeline mode on uploaded Map data, then disable timeline and verify those color edits persist.
primary_assertions: With timeline mode active at a deterministic uploaded-data checkpoint, a cluster-driven node color-table edit and a fixed link-color edit both update rendered Map layers immediately and both persist after Timeline is set back to None.
notes: The link side remains editable on this fixture through the fixed `link-color` input because `link-color-variable` stays `None` during the maintained timeline path.

file_types: uploaded node + link with date field
description: Click the timeline slider to a midpoint and back to the start while Map is active on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: Manual slider movement advances to the clicked date and keeps rendered Map node membership aligned with the oracle-backed set of timeline-visible nodes that actually have map coordinates.
notes: The earlier three-node mismatch was the persistent P1/P2/P3 place rows
last_reviewed: which stay timeline-visible on this fixture but never acquire map coordinates and therefore should not be counted as rendered Map nodes.

file_types: uploaded node + link with date field and zipcode mapping
description: Change uploaded Map node colors during timeline mode, then disable timeline and verify the edited node colors persist.
primary_assertions: With timeline mode active at a deterministic uploaded-data checkpoint, switching Color Nodes By to Cluster and editing a node color-table row updates rendered Map node colors immediately and the edited node color persists after Timeline is set back to None.
notes: This narrower node-only risk remains covered even though the broader node+link persistence combo is now covered as well.
